en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim Bin Hashim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus Bin Abdul Rahman, from Hamza Bin Muhammad Al Tayyar, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘There is no constriction (of sustenance) nor an extension (of sustenance) except for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> therein is a Desire, and Ordainment, and a Trial’.
en.sarwar: 1. It is narrated from Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Yunus ibn ‘Abd al-Rahman from Hamza ibn al-Tayyar from Imam abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) who has said the following. “
There is no expansion or reduction but that Allah therein has a wish, decree and testing.”
